messages:
marie_cs: FYI — Lumosys (prod account) usage tanked ~75% since Wed. Embedding requests went from ~90k/day -> ~12k/day. Their VP of ML (champion) left last week, new director is asking for "alternative options". Procurement pinged me about a MercuryAI pilot. Need quick renewal triage.

jason_am: ugh. renewal in 6 weeks?

marie_cs: yes, 5 weeks 3 days. ARR ~ $120k/yr, committed 2 reserved pools.

anya_csm: noted. do we have churn signals beyond token drop? seat activity? auth spikes?

devon_se: pulling infra metrics now. quick question — are they using streaming chat or batch embeddings primarily?

marie_cs: primarily batch embeddings + one low-latency rerank endpoint. numbers query: `SELECT date, sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE customer='lumosys' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 14;`

devon_se: ok grabbing logs. initial glance: batching job failed on 2026-03-10 (OOM) and retries dropped throughput. Could be a config regression in their scheduled job.

olga_prod: if MercuryAI is in the mix, procurement will ask about accuracy / latency / cost comparisons. Can SE prep a 1-pager that calls out model-parity + soft spots? :eyes: 

anya_csm: i'll reach out to their new director (cc'd in private msg) to schedule a 30-min discovery. ask: what's most important — cost reduction, latency, or model quality?

jason_am: also need to know discount threshold. suggest holding any deep concessions until we surface technical root cause. recommend a 2-week technical review + priority support.

devon_se: action for me: validate batch job config + check prefix/KV cache logs. If it's our runtime regression we own the fix. If it's customer job changes, summarize steps to restore throughput.

marie_cs: i'll send the outreach note and loop in their new director. drafting now: "we saw a drop after your weekly batch job; can we confirm schedule and container size? happy to run a quick runbook with you this week." any edits?

anya_csm: add ask for test prompts + sample dataset. also ask if they evaluated MercuryAI on embeddings or other features.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: #lumosys-triage 2026-03-20 10:30 — marie_cs, devon_se, anya_csm, jason_am, olga_prod

marie_cs: perfect. final ask — devon, please prepare: 1) 1-slide root cause hypothesis, 2) quick perf vs. mercury bullets, 3) rollback steps if we find config change. i'll prep the exec note for the director.

devon_se: will do. uploading initial charts to the triage doc in <link> :thumbsup:

jason_am: i'll set stakeholder map + procurement talking points. Let's reconvene after the tech call and decide offer cadence.

anya_csm: thanks team. I'll capture notes and follow-up tasks in the doc. -anya
